verdict.rationale: Portkey ships its own configurable rules that fire automatically on gateway events. Fallbacks trigger on configurable status codes, routing follows custom conditional checks, guardrails filter, fix or route requests in real time, and budget thresholds send notifications and block further usage. These rules only cover the LLM request pipeline and spend limits, not a general event-to-action automation engine. Missing for 10: a general-purpose rule/trigger builder for arbitrary events, user-defined custom actions (e.g. outbound webhooks or workflows), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
